title: Medical Research Discovery
description: Deploy a RAG-powered research assistant for medical literature. Uses Mosaic AI Vector Search, Foundation Model Serving (databricks-llama-3.1-8b-instruct), and a Databricks App. Compatible with Free Edition (1 VS endpoint, foundation model only).
objectives: Ingest 100 PubMed abstracts to Bronze layer
Chunk and embed abstracts using ai_embed() with the BGE large model
Create a Vector Search index synced to the Silver chunks table
Deploy a Databricks App that does RAG over the index using a foundation model
Pass all 4 validation queries with 100% accuracy

scenario.challenge: A clinical research team is buried under thousands of PubMed abstracts. They need a RAG assistant that gives evidence-backed answers in seconds, not days. The current pipeline has raw JSON dumps, no embeddings, no semantic search.
scenario.deployment: 4 notebooks + 1 vector index + 1 model serving endpoint + 1 Databricks App (Streamlit)

validations.name: Bronze Ingestion
validations.hint: Verify year filter uses >= (not >) — fix the comparison operator in notebook 01

validations.name: Silver Embeddings
validations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {catalog}.{schema_prefix}_silver.paper_chunks WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL
validations.hint: Use the full model name 'databricks-bge-large-en-v1.5' — the short name 'bge-large' fails

validations.name: Vector Index Online
validations.hint: Index needs SYNC SCHEDULE clause or it never syncs to the source table

validations.name: App Query Logged
validations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system.query.history WHERE statement_text LIKE '%medtech-rag%' AND start_time > current_timestamp - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
validations.hint: App entry point must be at bundle root as 'app.py' — not nested in a subdir

hintsNote: No SQL hints are provided in the notebooks. You must identify the issues and implement fixes using the briefing context and notebook error descriptions only.
